Document type
A green card is the United States permanent resident card. Outside the United States the same job is done by a permanent residence card, and sellers use the American term loosely for every country.

buy australian green card on telegram – the short version

A Australian green card is checked in five minutes by anybody who knows what the Department of Home Affairs prints. Ghost image, microprint, machine-readable zone, laminate edge, UV response. A seller with real stock will not mind you asking.

None of these checks need equipment beyond a loupe and a UV torch. Both cost less than the deposit on a single document and both last for years of buying.

Buy a Green Card via Telegram: how the transaction works

A serious seller of Australian Green Cards will send an uncropped photo of the card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame. Screenshots and cropped data pages are where problems hide.

When a seller is good, say so and keep them. A reliable contact in this market is worth more than a small saving, and repeat buyers get the better stock.

Who actually issues a Green Card

The Australian green card sits under the Department of Home Affairs and that office number format is published widely enough to test. A number that breaks the format is the fastest single proof that something is wrong.

That is why the authority question comes before the price question. A seller who knows the office knows the stock, and a seller who knows the stock can tell you what the number should look like.

Replica or registered original

If the card only has to look right across a counter, a print is enough and the bottom of the band is fair. If a number has to be looked up, pay the top and make the seller prove the lookup first.

This is the single most useful distinction on the page, because it explains the price spread better than anything else. A quote tells you which tier the seller thinks you are in.

What a fair price looks like

You will see Australian Green Cards below 320–1050 AUD described as original. Sometimes they are. More often a print has been priced and given a word it has not earned.

If a quote is far above the band, ask what the extra buys. A register check, a replacement guarantee and tracked delivery justify the top. Confidence alone does not.

The buying process, step by step

The steps below are deliberately boring. Boring is what a Australian green card purchase should feel like.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the Department of Home Affairs.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the Department of Home Affairs uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 320–1050 AUD band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

These are the tests that matter for a Australian green card. The two local ones are worth memorising.

  • Confirm the state crest and the state licence number pattern, which differs in every state and territory.
  • Check the passport for the kangaroo and emu watermark and the intaglio printing on the data page.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the Department of Home Affairs. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

If you see any of these, stop paying attention to the price.

  • A card that lists an address in a state other than the one in the header.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

What does a green card cost on Telegram?

Between 350 and 1600 US dollars. The top of the band is where a number that resolves at the immigration office should sit.

Is a green card the same as a residence permit?

In the United States yes, in practice. Elsewhere the green card is the permanent tier and the residence permit is the fixed term tier below it.

Can the number be checked?

Only against the immigration register. Ask the seller which register the number sits in and expect a specific answer.

Why are green cards so expensive?

Because the number carries the most weight of any document here and the register check is the hardest to fake.

What is the usual fake?

A high quality print of a real card with the number left intact and the personal details changed.

Before you pay
